nombre: Collage de 3 fotos con checks y precio
descripcion: Banda superior oscura a todo el ancho con el nombre o la categoría del producto en blanco, y un sello circular rojo con un reclamo de confianza en la esquina superior derecha. Debajo, un collage de 3 fotos a sangre: una lifestyle a todo el ancho en la mitad superior, con el público disfrutando el producto en uso, y dos en la mitad inferior (a la izquierda, una persona poniéndoselo o usándolo; a la derecha, un macro del producto puesto). Sobre la unión, a la izquierda, 3 checks verdes con píldoras oscuras de texto (palabra clave en negrita) y, en el centro inferior, un precio rojo grande con un «por sólo» encima. Al pie, una banda negra delgada y, montada sobre su borde superior (mitad sobre las fotos), una píldora blanca con ícono de camión y la condición de pago. Las fotos se unen con cortes rectos, sin separadores. El producto nunca aparece recortado: se entiende puesto, en las fotos.
reference_style: Busy, high-trust LATAM cash-on-delivery collage ad: a dark title band, one wide lifestyle photo over two smaller in-use photos, overlaid green check pills, a big red price and a black bottom band with a white payment pill

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The wide lifestyle photo with happy people using the product. 2) The big red price in the lower center. 3) The product name in the top band and the red seal in the corner. 4) The three check pills. 5) The macro photo of the product in place. 6) The payment pill in the bottom band.
art_direction.composition_style: Edge-to-edge photo grid of 1 wide photo on top and 2 photos below, framed by a dark band at the top and a black band at the bottom. Graphic elements float over the photo seams: the check pills cross the horizontal seam on the left, the price block crosses the vertical seam in the lower center, and the round seal overlaps the top band and the top photo in the upper-right corner.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Top band: full width, from 0% to about 8% of the canvas height. Top photo: full width, from about 8% to 56.5% of the height. Bottom-left photo: from 0% to about 59.5% of the width and 56.5% to 95.5% of the height. Bottom-right photo: from about 59.5% to 100% of the width, same height band. The photos butt directly against each other with hard straight seams: no gutters, frames or borders between them. Seal: circle about 13-14% of the canvas in diameter, centered at about 91% of the width and 13% of the height. Check pills: three rows from about 2% to 44% of the width, at about 41-46%, 48-53% and 56-61% of the height (row pitch about 7.3%); check circle about 5.5% in diameter at about 2-7.5% of the width, pill from about 9% to 44% of the width. Price block: from about 36% to 68% of the width; small label at about 65-68% of the height (centered over the figure), price figure at about 69.5-77% of the height. Bottom band: thin, full width, from about 95.5% to 100% of the height. White pill: from about 25% to 75% of the width and about 92.5% to 97.5% of the height, straddling the seam between the bottom photos and the black band (about half over the photos, half over the band).
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Photos: bright, warm, natural indoor light, realistic stock-photo quality, faces and product sharp, homes softly blurred behind. Graphic overlays are flat: the pills are solid dark with a thin white outline, the check circles are flat green with a white check, the seal is a flat red disc with a thin dashed outer ring, and the price is solid red with a thin white outline for separation from the photo. No glows or 3D effects.

layout_summary: Square canvas. A dark navy band across the top holds the product name in white. A red round seal with a thin dashed ring overlaps the band and the photo in the top-right corner. The upper half is a wide lifestyle photo of the target audience enjoying the product in use. The lower half splits into two photos: on the left, a person putting on or using the product in close-up; on the right, a macro of the product in place. Three green check circles with dark rounded text pills are stacked on the left over the seam between the upper and lower photos. A big red price with a small label above sits in the lower center over the seam between the two lower photos. A thin black band runs along the very bottom, and a centered white pill with a delivery-truck icon and the payment condition straddles its top edge, half over the lower photos. The photos meet with hard seams, without gutters.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Full width, from 0% to about 8% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Names the product before anything else
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Solid band in a saturated deep indigo blue (or the brand's darkest saturated color) holding the product name or category in white, centered.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Top-right corner, circle about 13-14% of the canvas in diameter, centered at about 91% of the width and 13% of the height, overlapping the bottom edge of the top band and the top photo
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Answers the main purchase doubt with one short claim
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Flat red disc with a thin dashed ring just outside its edge and a 2-line white text inside. Write a short trust claim adapted to the user's product and its main objection (for example no prescription needed, original product, guarantee or certification), using only claims the user can back.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Full width, from about 8% to 56.5% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows the emotional result: the target audience happy while using the product
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Bright, warm photo in a real home of one or two people from the target audience enjoying the product in use (for example one person helping the other put it on and both laughing). Faces large and expressive, the product visible in use. Keep the left part of its lower edge (from about 40% to 56% of the height and 0% to 45% of the width) calm because the check pills sit there.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Bottom left, from 0% to about 59.5% of the canvas width and 56.5% to 95.5% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows how the product is put on or used
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Close-up of a person from the target audience putting on, applying or using the user's product exactly as in the attached product photo, hands and face in profile, soft light. Keep the right part of the photo calm because the price sits there.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Bottom right, from about 59.5% to 100% of the canvas width and 56.5% to 95.5% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows the real product up close, in place, so its size and look are clear
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Macro photo of the user's product exactly as in the attached product photo (same geometry, materials and colors), worn or placed where it is used (on the body, on the surface, in the device), filling most of the frame, sharp, shallow depth of field.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Left, from about 2% to 44% of the canvas width, rows at about 41-46%, 48-53% and 56-61% of the height, crossing the seam between the top and bottom photos
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Three quick reasons to buy, readable over the photos
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Each row: a flat green circle about 5.5% of the canvas in diameter with a white check, followed by a fully rounded dark navy pill with a thin white outline holding one short white feature line, keyword in bold and the rest in regular. All rows the same width.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Lower center, from about 36% to 68% of the canvas width and 65% to 77% of the height, over the seam between the two bottom photos
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Anchors the offer with one big figure
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Small red uppercase label centered above a very large red price figure, both with a thin white outline. Use the exact price and currency the user gave; never invent a figure.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Thin full-width band from about 95.5% to 100% of the canvas height, touching the left, right and bottom edges; the white pill sits at about 25-75% of the width and 92.5-97.5% of the height, straddling the band's top edge
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Removes the payment risk at the last glance
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Solid black band with a centered white fully rounded pill with a thin dark outline (about 25-75% of the width, about 5% tall) that straddles the band's top edge, half over the bottom photos. The pill holds a small colored delivery-truck icon with speed lines on its left and the payment or shipping condition in dark text, key words in bold.

text_layers.reference_function: product name in the top band
text_layers.text_style: Bold sans-serif, sentence case, white, about 4.5-5% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered, up to about 85% of the width so it does not touch the seal
text_layers.guia_texto: Qué es el producto: su categoría o nombre + su función, en 3 a 6 palabras.

text_layers.text_style: Bold sans-serif, white, about 3.3% of the canvas height, 2 lines (first in sentence case, second in uppercase), centered
text_layers.guia_texto: Un reclamo de confianza que responde la duda principal del producto (sin receta, original, garantía, certificado), en 2 palabras. Solo lo que el usuario pueda respaldar.

text_layers.text_style: Sans-serif, white, about 3% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered in the pill; the keyword in extra bold and the rest in regular
text_layers.guia_texto: Beneficio o característica más fuerte para el ángulo: palabra clave en negrita + 1 o 2 palabras de cierre, de 2 a 4 palabras en total.
Segunda característica concreta con la palabra clave en negrita, de 2 a 4 palabras.
Tercera característica (durabilidad, resistencia o facilidad) con la palabra clave en negrita, de 2 a 4 palabras.

text_layers.reference_position: Lower center, directly above the price figure
text_layers.text_style: Extra bold sans-serif, uppercase, red with a thin white outline, about 3.3% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered over the figure
text_layers.guia_texto: Etiqueta corta que introduce el precio y lo hace sentir accesible, de 2 palabras.

text_layers.reference_position: Lower center, from about 36% to 68% of the width
text_layers.text_style: Extra bold sans-serif, red with a thin white outline, about 7.5-8% of the canvas height (cap height), 1 line, centered, maximum visual weight among the overlays
text_layers.guia_texto: El precio real que dio el usuario con su moneda. Solo cifra y moneda.

text_layers.reference_position: Inside the white pill that straddles the top edge of the bottom band, right of the truck icon
text_layers.text_style: Sans-serif, near-black, about 3.3% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered; the key words in bold and the rest in regular
text_layers.guia_texto: La forma de pago o la condición de envío real que dio el usuario, en 2 a 4 palabras, con las palabras clave en negrita.

mandatory_visual_elements: Edge-to-edge 1 + 2 photo collage with hard seams and no gutters
Wide lifestyle photo of the target audience using the product in the upper half
Close-up of a person putting on or using the product and a macro of the product in place in the lower half
Dark top band with the product name and a red round seal overlapping its corner
Three green check circles with dark rounded text pills over the left seam
Big red price with a small label above, over the lower seam
Thin black bottom band with a white pill straddling its top edge, holding a truck icon and the payment condition
forbidden_additions: Isolated product cut-out or studio packshot
Struck-through old price or discount percentage badge
White gutters, frames or borders between the photos
notas_paleta: Paleta de venta directa: banda superior en azul índigo intenso y saturado (o el color oscuro más saturado de la marca) con texto blanco; sello y precio en rojo intenso con borde blanco; checks en verde; píldoras de texto en azul marino casi negro con borde blanco; banda inferior negra y delgada con píldora blanca y texto casi negro. Las fotos llevan colores naturales y cálidos; la marca aparece solo en detalles de las fotos.
